implementation_evidence.scope: Host-verified source admission and synthetic CPU checks only. No proof of mechanism, recommendation benefit, training protocol overrides or final-test performance.

sequence_semantics.scope: Finite synthetic eval-mode probes of input immutability and full-sequence batch independence; not all-input or proposal-specific semantic proof.

structural_changes.scope: AST locations and assigned model fields only; comments and formatting ignored. Does not verify semantic insertion contracts, full tensor dataflow or causal isolation.

tensor_graph.scope: Dispatched tensor operations for this concrete encode_sequence input and execution mode. Includes functional and mutation dependencies; excludes unexecuted branches, Python scalar/control flow and operator internals. Not a universal static graph or semantic insertion proof.

instructions: Evaluate the actual complete development readout. Include its exact hash in evidence_refs: 07fac7f27ce8e5bc4c556f12d4ed9fdd695217136d9967205f31c7afec7dc13d

incumbent_measurement_context, when present, contains measurements of bindings.base_model_id only. They motivated the proposal; they are not measurements of the candidate or evidence that its mechanism succeeded.

implementation_author_report preserves the experiment role reported checks and limitations. Its verified identity does not verify any claimed check. Compare it with the proposal correctness_checks/falsification_condition and host evidence; explicitly retain unexecuted or unsupported validations in unresolved_explanations. Do not equate completion of training and primary-metric selection with completion of every proposed diagnostic or scientific test.

implementation_evidence reports host-verified admission checks; its report hashes are references, not files available in your workspace. When structural_changes is supplied, compare its actual changed methods and assigned fields with the proposal insertion contract; AST evidence does not prove that semantic contract. tensor_graph summarizes verified executed tensor paths; unavailable means no recorded coverage. Never infer unexecuted branch coverage or causal isolation from operator counts. sequence_semantics reports finite input-immutability and per-user batch-independence probes, not proof of the proposal-specific mechanism. Distinguish these checks from missing scientific evidence. Evaluation has no source file; lead receives candidate source separately.

candidate_execution_evidence summarizes audited completed development training under the frozen worker and protocol. Use verified fields to assess actual execution settings, rather than local model helper defaults. training_contract distinguishes fresh pre-training probes from probes bound to the selected trained development checkpoint; unavailable means no archived gates. These are synthetic checks, not held-out recommendation quality. It does not prove a causal mechanism or expose confirmation results.
Keep only if eligible_for_confirmation is true. No confirmation results are supplied; conclusion unknown/provisional.

Promotion is decided by host baseline-only metrics for candidate AND generated controls. A control winning does not veto a useful candidate; scientific mechanism conclusions remain separate. Record alternative explanations and the next discriminating experiment, including negative and null contrasts.

generated_control_evidence binds each new control to its own source admission and completed development execution. These checks do not establish that the control isolates the proposed mechanism; assess that separately from the paired outcomes.
Return decision and knowledge in one response. knowledge.patch_json is an append-only graph patch at patch_contract.base_version. Use only supplied node IDs as evidence; empty patch is valid.

Every new node.attrs must copy task_id, protocol_hash, origin, scope and status from patch_contract.node_attrs_template. Graph task_id may differ from the campaign task_id. Add evidence_refs and your scientific content inside attrs; do not omit scope on Claims.

Record candidate/control interventions, outcome differences, alternative explanations and next discriminating tests as provisional knowledge. Negative/null evidence is retained. Training success and code review do not establish causal mechanisms.
Existing historical explanation nodes may be linked by BASED_ON, SUPERSEDES or ALTERNATIVE_TO using current scoped development evidence. Never rewrite historical nodes.

alternative_explanations: A gain could come from optimization or checkpoint selection.
The control and candidate have matched parameters but different perturbation distributions.
A four-category mean could conceal category regressions.
design.falsification_condition: Reject implementation admission if CPU or scoring contracts fail. The ranking prediction fails if candidate mean HR@10 is at most 0.60425, candidate mean is at most the generated control's mean, or the host eligibility gate is false. A passing development contrast remains provisional rather than causal confirmation.
design.insertion_contract: {"schema":"nextitnet-method-scope-v1","allowed_methods":["NextItNetModel.__init__","NextItNetModel.encode_sequence"],"rationale":"Add an identically initialized hidden-width parameter vector in both arms. In model.py, use it for a bounded featurewise disagreement adjustment to the existing compressed-state blend. In control-1.py, use it for a matched-parameter common-mode adjustment. Preserve context construction, masking, fallback, and scoring methods."}
design.mechanism: Compare featurewise allocation toward or away from preceding context against the incumbent fixed blend and a matched-parameter common-mode calibration control. The contrast tests the provisional disagreement-allocation explanation; independent fits cannot alone prove it.
predicted_observations: At initialization, candidate and generated control exactly match the incumbent readout.
After a synthetic parameter update, the candidate changes features where current and context states differ; the control changes their common-mode representation.
If featurewise context allocation helps ranking, candidate mean HR@10 exceeds both 0.60425 and the generated control's mean.

mechanism_comparisons.next_step: Assess whether the implemented contrast isolates the proposed mechanism; design a discriminating follow-up for competing explanations.
mechanism_comparisons.qualification: Paired development observation, not causal proof or independent replication.

instruction_identity.skill_visibility: No Skill files explicitly supplied by this transport; CLI automatic Skill discovery and execution are not recorded.

You are the rec-harness analyst agent. Analyze the audited public development outcomes and mechanism contrasts, retaining negative and null results. In one call return a decision explanation and a knowledge GraphPatch against the supplied graph and patch_contract. Performance selection belongs to the host. Scientific claims stay provisional/unknown; never invent evidence or inspect confirmation. Record competing explanations and the next discriminating experiment.

Read /workspace/context.json and inspect /workspace/model when supplied. This is an OS-isolated public research workspace. Do not read credentials or unrelated paths. Do not spawn other agents or execute GPU training. Return exactly the required JSON schema. For changes, paths are relative to model/. Preserve the frozen protocol and unrelated code. Use only supplied evidence. Do not retrieve external sources; mark missing sources unknown.
